title: Devices
subtitle: Click a device to adjust it.
wledHint: LED strips with a WLED controller (ESP32/ESP8266) on your network
conflictText: Two programs controlling the same device cause flickering and wrong colors. Close it to use Hydraflow.
noHid: HID module unavailable: hardware control is disabled.
noneHint: Built-in support: ASUS Aura boards, Wooting keyboards, Corsair memory, WLED strips and RGB NVIDIA and AMD graphics cards.
ramNoAnswer: The memory didn't respond. Restart Hydraflow to finish activating.
ramNoAccessText: {error}. Restart Hydraflow; if it keeps happening, restart your computer (a newly installed driver sometimes only loads after that).
ramSupport: Currently supported: Corsair Vengeance RGB / Dominator (DDR4 and DDR5). More brands will come in future versions.
ramPermissionHint: Windows asks for confirmation only once
ramText: Hydraflow controls the memory directly over the SMBus, without other programs. One click installs what's missing and turns it on.
wledExists: This WLED is already in the list
wledText: LED strips connected to an ESP32/ESP8266 board running WLED firmware (the most popular for DIY Ambilight). They show up as devices: place them in Lighting → Layout, for example behind your monitor, and use Screen Ambience.
disabled: Device off — control goes back to the hardware
defaultsText: The ARGB channels were set up automatically with a placeholder strip. It works without doing anything, but to make the effect match your PC, choose the real fans/strips.
noGeometry: The plugin hasn't reported the device geometry yet.
tuneInvalid: The clipboard doesn't contain a valid tuning
restoreTuneText: Reset the color tuning to default?
tuneHint: Compensates for color differences between devices.
minHint: Colors darker than the threshold are turned off (avoids LEDs flickering at very low levels)
componentsHint: Build on each channel the chain of fans/strips connected to it, in the same physical order. Each component becomes an item you can place in Layout.
needPositive: Enter a number greater than zero
overLimit: The chain exceeds the channel limit: LEDs beyond the limit won't be sent.
noComponents: No components. Use "Blink channel" in the ⋯ menu to find out which header this is.
placeholder: automatic placeholder (replace with the real component)
paintHint: Click or drag over the LEDs. Painted LEDs ignore the effect and keep the chosen color.
clearPaintText: Remove all painting from this device?
nothingToPaint: No LEDs to paint (turn the device on or add components).
